surface_rendering.ordering_rule: The protocol emoji and recovered protocol lexeme are primary. The current host-language term follows in square brackets as an access gloss.
surface_rendering.host_language_rule: The bracketed term is rendered in the language currently hosting the interaction or document. It may change with the host language without changing the canonical protocol lexeme.
surface_rendering.nonreplacement_rule: A host-language gloss must not replace, precede, or silently flatten the protocol lexeme in ordinary Caeluviim surface output.
surface_rendering.omission_rule: The bracketed gloss may be omitted only in a protocol-native context where the audience has explicitly selected gloss-free rendering.

recovery_sequence.meaning_of_recovery: Recovery into Caeluviim from English-centered conceptual partitioning; not recovery from Anishinaabe speakers or communities, who preserved and continue the living language.
recovery_sequence.significance: The protocol begins its multilingual reconstruction with 👤 Anishinaabe [person], foregrounding the bearer of dignity, relation, agency, memory, and recognition before institutional abstractions.
recovery_sequence.nonappropriation_rule: Protocol adoption records gratitude, source, limits, and community authority. It does not claim ownership of the word, authority over the language, or representation of Anishinaabe peoples.

concept_emoji.selection_basis: Abstract singular-person marker without encoded gender or skin-tone selection.

input_aliases.status: user-input normalization alias; not canonical spelling

attested_semantic_range: an Indian or Native in contrast to a non-Native
a person or human in contrast to a non-human being

protocol_semantics.decision: Anishinaabe is the Caeluviim protocol word for Person.
protocol_semantics.surface_use_rule: In ordinary English-hosted Caeluviim output, emit 👤 Anishinaabe [person] rather than replacing the recovered word with Person or person alone.
protocol_semantics.extension_rule: Caeluviim may apply the Person category to human, disputed, relational, machine-mediated, or other candidates for personhood. Any application beyond the attested human sense is a Caeluviim protocol extension and must not be represented as an attested community-language meaning.
protocol_semantics.nonflattening_rule: The protocol use must preserve the word's Ojibwe, Native, human, and relational semantic dimensions rather than reducing it to a context-free replacement token for English person.
protocol_semantics.typing_rule: An entity may be typed as Anishinaabe in the protocol while retaining concurrent legal, biological, cultural, technical, symbolic, and relational classifications.

source.title: Ojibwe People's Dictionary — anishinaabe
source.institutional_basis: University of Minnesota Department of American Indian Studies and University Libraries

governance.initiating_authority: Explicit user instructions on 2026-08-06 selecting Anishinaabe for Person and correcting the required glyph-first, bracketed-host-language rendering.
governance.ratification_scope: The user ratifies the Caeluviim protocol selection of Anishinaabe for Person and the surface form 👤 Anishinaabe [person]. External linguistic, cultural, legal, or institutional acceptance is not asserted.
governance.speaker_contestation_rule: Any eligible Anishinaabemowin speaker or source-community participant may submit an objection concerning spelling, gloss, semantic extension, first-recovered-word framing, provenance, active use, or the associated protocol rendering.
governance.suspension_rule: A facially valid objection changes the entry to SUSPENDED_PENDING_SPEAKER_VOTE and pauses canonical emission, recommendation, and new deployment. Suspension is procedural and does not adjudicate the merits.
governance.collective_disposition_rule: No individual, small group, institution, or Caeluviim maintainer may decide final status for the speaker body. Retention, revision, narrowing, replacement, removal, or historical-only status requires a speaker-wide ballot conducted under rules first ratified by participating speakers.
governance.universal_franchise_rule: Every reasonably reachable eligible speaker must have an equal opportunity to receive notice, deliberate, propose alternatives, and vote. Consultation with one institution, locality, family, or online group is not a full speaker vote.
governance.insufficient_participation_rule: If speaker-ratified outreach, quorum or participation, verification, and decision-threshold conditions are not met, the entry remains SUSPENDED_UNRESOLVED. A small participating group does not acquire default authority.
governance.implementation_rule: The valid speaker-wide result controls active status. Replacement or removal ends canonical emission while retaining a tombstoned provenance and dissent record.
governance.revision_rule: Future speaker, community, linguistic, or protocol review may refine orthography, scope, inflection, emoji assignment, host-language glosses, protocol usage, or election procedure without erasing decision history.
